svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut one 90 x 87.5 mm blank of 4 mm plate; round the corners 3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure up from the bottom edge and sideways from the centre line:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rail and housing bolts 6.5 mm at 12.5 up, 35 each side;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shaft clearance hole 16 mm at 42.5 up, centred;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outboard bearing bolts 6.5 mm on the centre line, 18.5 and 66.5 up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: inboard bearing bolts 6.5 mm at 42.5 up, 24 each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 4.2 mm and tap M5 at 30.9 up, 31.9 to the rear of centre

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure your two bearings first: move the bolt holes to suit them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the outside face of the chain-side rail, bottom edge flush with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the rail bottom, centred 350 mm behind the rail front; one bearing

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on each face, the inboard one clear of the rail top by 2.5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the shaft hole is square to the plate; bearing bolts line up.
